resolution: Generation 1 closes the hardware-independent CaptureBroker core at bounded repository-hosted component-CI scope. It establishes single-owner/multiple-reader ownership, bounded RAM-only FrameRef fan-out, deterministic eviction, slow-consumer gap signalling and source-generation rebind semantics. It deliberately does not establish any physical camera/display/browser capture, local OS permission integration, target perception runtime, VPS runtime, GRID10/GWT/J-Space runtime, provider/VLM execution, effect/completion or whole-system acceptance.
next_exact_action: Continue the canonical Perception Fabric frontier without duplicating WP709. Prioritize the next unclaimed dependency-correct perception package, while preserving that final local Claude Code/Opus work should only bind actual OS/device adapters and perform physical acceptance.
